summary: 120 Beer is 24 batches, each 1 Wheat + 1 Stick. Plant Wheat early (Miranda speeds it), raise a Brewery, and in parallel build the Clay Pit and Brickyard for four Brick Houses (48 Bricks). Expand Corn so the Veggie stock climbs past 100 despite twelve mouths.

build_order.note: About 30 tiles straight away: Beer needs 24 Wheat and the crop is the slowest step.
15 Planks + 4 Stone; 5 Beer per Wheat and Stick.
Add tiles to the 45 already planted (7-day crop, 2 each) until the Veggie stock passes 100.

pitfalls: Sticks are the hidden bottleneck: Beer, Bricks and three buildings all need them and there is no Firewood Yard.
The Veggie objective counts stock; villagers eating Veggies push it back down, so keep the Foragers' Huts busy.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
